definitions.explanation: a factory where iron ore is smelted and processed into iron or steel

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{製鉄所|せいてつじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large steel mill in this town.

examples.japanese: {製鉄所|せいてつじょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: White smoke is rising from the steelworks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧{北九州|きたきゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製鉄所|せいてつじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いていた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear my grandfather worked at a steelworks in Kitakyushu when he was young.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{製鉄|せいてつ}→製鉄：24078_seitetsu⟧ (steelmaking, iron production) + {所|じょ} (place, facility). Japan has a long history of steel production, with major steelworks in cities like {北九州|きたきゅうしゅう} ({八幡製鉄所|やはたせいてつじょ}) and {室蘭|むろらん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製鉄所|せいてつじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work at a steel mill
- {製鉄所|せいてつじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡地|あとち}→跡地：14281_atochi⟧: former site of a steelworks
- {高炉|こうろ}: blast furnace (key equipment in a steelworks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製鋼所|せいこうじょ}: steel refinery — focuses on the steel refining process specifically
- {鋳造所|ちゅうぞうじょ}: foundry — a facility for casting metals
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: factory — general term for any manufacturing facility

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {八幡製鉄所|やはたせいてつじょ} in {北九州|きたきゅうしゅう} was Japan's first modern steel mill, established in 1901. It played a central role in Japan's industrialization and is now part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
